record.paper_title: Group actions on 4-manifolds: some recent results and open questions
record.context_brief: Whether A5 symmetry forces a standard symplectic homotopy K3
record.original_question: Suppose a symplectic homotopy K3 surface X admits a symplectic action of A5. Must X be standard, meaning that its exoticness invariant satisfies r_X = 0?

evidence.quote: The rank rX of the lattice LX gives a rough measurement of the exoticness of the smooth structure of X, with rX = 0 being the least exotic ... (We will call X “standard” if rX = 0.)
Question 3.2. (Chen-Kwasik [21]) Suppose a symplectic homotopy K3 surface X admits a symplectic A5-action. Is X necessarily “standard” (i.e., rX = 0)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a symplectic homotopy K3 surface, i.e. a closed smooth 4-manifold homeomorphic to a K3 surface and equipped with a symplectic form ω. Define the lattice
  L_X = span_{ℤ}{ β ∈ H_2(X; ℤ) : SW_X(β) ≠ 0 },
where SW_X denotes the Seiberg–Witten invariant, and let r_X be the rank of L_X. Call X "standard" if r_X = 0.

Suppose X admits a symplectic action of the alternating group A_5 (i.e. a faithful action by diffeomorphisms preserving ω). Must X be standard, that is, must r_X = 0?
artifact.status_search_result: Related work by Chen and Kwasik establishes that effective symplectic actions by various maximal K3 groups force the homotopy K3 to be minimally exotic, and follow-up papers (e.g. on S_5 actions) extend this. However, no source found explicitly resolves the A_5 case in full. The status of this specific question is not clearly settled in the literature consulted.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric symplectic homotopy K3 surfaces (Chen–Kwasik)
status_evidence.snippet: Initiates the study of the smooth structure of symplectic homotopy K3 surfaces via symplectic symmetries; defines r_X and discusses A_5 fixed-point bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework and partial results but does not resolve A_5 case in general.

status_evidence.title: Symplectic S_5 action on symplectic homotopy K3 surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Treats S_5 symplectic actions on homotopy K3, extending the Chen–Kwasik program.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses S_5 rather than the A_5 question specifically.
